reps.name: Stanley Kim
reps.headlineGap: Only 1 of 6 calls hit 4+ options — strong diagnosis, single-path presentation
focus: Week 1: Write the 4-option menu for your 3 most common repairs. Practice building it from diagnosis notes before walking back to the customer.
Week 2: Script the expectations opening. Say it out loud before every call this week until it's automatic.
Week 3: Add membership to every option menu — even for existing members (referral ask). Track SAM mentions per call.

reps.name: Pedro Manzanares
reps.headlineGap: 0 of 4 calls hit 4+ options — single repair paths only
focus: Week 1: For every diagnosis, write 4 options on paper before presenting. Practice until it's automatic.
Week 2: Script the expectations opening. Deliver it on every call this week.
Week 3: When customer defers, practice the follow-up: <q>What would help you decide today?</q>

reps.name: Joseph Byrd
reps.headlineGap: Passive close language — said "you don't have to decide right away"
focus: Week 1: Write 4 options for every diagnosis before presenting. No single-option presentations this week.
Week 2: Replace <q>you don't have to decide</q> with <q>which one works best?</q> Practice 10 times before each call.
Week 3: Add SAM to every options menu. Track mentions per call.

reps.name: Matthew Arnold
reps.headlineGap: Financing as afterthought — mentioned after customer declined
focus: Week 1: Build monthly payment into every option presentation. <q>$2,200 or about $90/month.</q>
Week 2: When customer cites budget, respond with: <q>If we could make this work at $X/month, would that change things?</q>
Week 3: For existing members: thank them, mention warranty, ask for referrals.

reps.name: J Boothe
reps.headlineGap: Options positioned as FYI — "more telling you about it than a sales pitch"
focus: Week 1: After presenting options, say: <q>Which of these would you like to move forward with today?</q> Practice 10x daily.
Week 2: Script the expectations opening. Deliver on every call.
Week 3: Remove all informational framing. Options are choices, not FYI.

reps.name: Josue Arciga
reps.headlineGap: Single repair paths only — 0 of 3 calls hit 4+ options
focus: Week 1: Write 4 options for every diagnosis before presenting. No single-option presentations.
Week 2: Script the expectations opening. Deliver on every call.
Week 3: SAM on every options menu — not just renewals.

reps.name: Chris Thomas
reps.headlineGap: Pre-qualifying mindset — "I'm not even gonna try" on moving customer
focus: Week 1: Present options to EVERY customer — even moving ones. No pre-qualifying.
Week 2: Script expectations opening and close ask. Deliver both on every call.
Week 3: When customer defers, ask: <q>When would be a good time to reconnect?</q> Set follow-up.

reps.name: Jack Vanos
reps.headlineGap: No structured menu — verbal quotes only, no tablet presentation
focus: Week 1: Build visual options menu on tablet for every diagnosis. 4+ options minimum.
Week 2: Script expectations opening. Deliver on every call.
Week 3: When customer defers to spouse, offer to present to both together via speakerphone.

reps.name: Juan Bernal
reps.headlineGap: Only 2 options presented — strong welcome, half a menu
focus: Week 1: Build 4+ options with pricing for every diagnosis.
Week 2: Add SAM to every options menu.
Week 3: After presenting, ask: <q>Which of these works best for you?</q>

reps.name: Matthew Graves
reps.headlineGap: No options on courtesy visit — missed proactive opportunity
focus: Week 1: Present at least one option on every call — even courtesy visits.
Week 2: Document diagnosis clearly — never <q>I don't know what I did.</q>
Week 3: Script expectations opening. Deliver on every call.

reps.name: Adrian Muniz
reps.headlineGap: Single solution path — closed $2,900 but no good/better/best
focus: Week 1: Build 4+ options for every major repair: repair, repair + surge, repair + extended, full package.
Week 2: Continue strong SAM enrollment — now add surge protection to the menu.
Week 3: Capture full calls to review welcome and expectations.

reps.name: Fabian Pantoja
reps.headlineGap: Incomplete transcript — 12 min recording ends before options
focus: Week 1: Script expectations opening. Deliver on every call.
Week 2: Ensure recording captures full call from arrival to close.
Week 3: Continue strong diagnostic questioning. Add options framework.
